Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed today by learned A.G.A. for the State is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State of U.P. and perused the record.
3.

The present second bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant involved in S.T.
No.629 of 2021, arising out of Case Crime No.131 of 2021 under Sections 363, 372, 373 and 376 I.P.C., Sections 3, 4, 17, 18 POCSO Act & Section 9 of Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, Police Station-Thakur Ganj, District - Lucknow, with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the innocent applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He has further submitted that the F.I.R. in question was lodged on the basis of concocted facts and that, after recovery, all three victims were sent to a counseling centre.
A report was prepared by the counselor, Ms. Sonal Srivastava, dated 01.03.2021, in which the victims stated that their movement was restricted by their parents; as a result, they left their house.
The applicant allegedly insisting the victims to wear minimum clothes for the purposes of modeling.

However, they developed some apprehension that they would be sold out, so they went to Delhi and stayed at the house of Nazia, then came to Varanasi and stayed at the house of Muskan, a friend of Reshma.
Later, Muskan expelled them and they then went to Lucknow at Charbagh and stayed in a rented room.
In the meantime, the father of one victim found them.
Thereafter, the police recovered them and took them to the police station.
The victims also undertook that they would not leave home without informing their family members.
5. He further submitted that all the victims refused medico-legal examination.

The first bail application of the applicant was rejected on 18.01.2023, with a direction to the learned trial court to conclude the trial expeditiously, if possible within a period of one year, without granting any unnecessary adjournments to either party.
The Commissioner of Police, Lucknow, as well as the Joint Director of Prosecution, Lucknow, were also directed to ensure the presence of witnesses before the trial court.
The office was also directed to communicate this order to the trial court, the Commissioner of Police, Lucknow, and the Joint Director of Prosecution, Lucknow, for necessary compliance forthwith.
However, till today, the trial has not been concluded.
6. He further submitted that the applicant, who is a lady, does not have any criminal antecedents.
As all the witnesses of fact have already been examined and she is ready to cooperate in the trial, in these circumstances, the applicant is entitled to bail.
In case she is enlarged on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail.

7. Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer made by learned counsel for the applicant and submitted that all the victims have categorically supported the prosecution version in their deposition before the trial court.
However, he does not dispute the fact that at the time of rejection of the first bail application, a direction was issued for conclusion of the trial within the stipulated period.

8. Considering the rival submissions of learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A., the material available on record, the contents of the F.I.R., and other relevant documents including the first bail rejection order dated 18.01.2023 and the report of the learned trial Judge dated 14.07.2025, wherein it has been stated that bailable warrant has already been issued to PW-6 for cross-examination and that notice under Section 350 Cr.P.C. has also been issued as well as the fact that the applicant has remained in jail since 28.03.2021 and all the witnesses of fact have already been examined and the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

9. Let applicant - Smt. Rubi - be released on bail in aforesaid Case Crime, on her furnishing personal bond and two reliable sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned Smt. Rubi vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Home Civil ... on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21863972/
2 subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not commit or participate in any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which she is suspected.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that she shall not seek any adjournment on the date fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in Court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(iv) The applicant shall remain present before the Trial Court on each date fixed,
either personally or through her counsel.

sentences.text: In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the Trial Court may proceed against him under Section 229-A IPC/269 BNS.

(v) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure her presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C./84 BNS, may be issued and if applicant fails to appear before the Court on the date fixed in such proclamation,
then, the Trial Court shall initiate proceedings against her, in accordance with law,
under Section 174-A IPC/209 BNS.

(vi) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the Trial Court on dates fixed for (1) opening of the case, (2) framing of charge and (3) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C./351 BNS.

If in the opinion of the Trial Court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against her in accordance with law.
10. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
